summary: Backend-only end-to-end testing of the new ServisPro Interim/Temp-staffing module (28 pytest cases). Covers admin settings (commission %, payment_methods CRUD), full mission lifecycle (create → list → apply → accept → auto-close → complete → commission math 10% & 15%), provider auto-suspension after mission completion, payment-proof submission validation (orange_money/mtn_money/bank/other + transfer_reference required), admin validate/reject flow, suspension toggle on validate, and access-control (provider cannot create mission, company cannot hit admin settings). All 28 tests pass against the preview backend (DB: servispro_dev).

minor.issue: When a non-provider token (e.g. company JWT) is used on /interim/missions/{id}/apply, the dependency returns 401 'User not found' rather than a more explicit 403. Minor — behaviour is safe.
Returns 500 when no profile_photo is supplied (Cloudinary upload pipeline). Not part of interim module but blocks easy seed of test providers — bypassed by direct DB insert in tests.

critical_code_review_comments: interim.py L162: delete_mission blocks delete only when accepted_count>0, but a mission could be 'completed' with commissions already generated and still be deletable here — consider also blocking deletion when status in ('closed','completed').
interim.py L223: list_mission_applications fetches mission with projection {'_id':0,'id':1} but only uses it for the existence/ownership check. Fine but slightly misleading.

interim.py L317-318: commission_amount uses round() (banker's rounding for ties via Python's round). For GNF currency this is OK, but it's worth documenting that rounding is to the nearest integer GNF.

interim.py L376-405 submit_commission_payment: there is no check that the caller is the owner — it's done by querying `{'id': commission_id, 'provider_id': current_user['id']}` which is correct; just noting that a non-owner gets 404 (good).

interim.py L494 admin_reject_commission: does NOT check the current status — a 'validated' commission could be re-rejected via this endpoint. Recommend asserting status in ('submitted','pending') before allowing reject.
interim.py L295-350 complete_mission: if a mission has zero accepted applications it still flips status to 'completed' (with 0 commissions). Probably intended, but worth confirming with product.

Auto-suspension flag write (`db.service_providers.update_one`) on complete_mission only updates `service_providers`; if the platform ever has providers stored in another collection (none today) this would be incomplete — fine for now.
interim.py uses inline string literals for the four payment_method values; consider extracting to a constant/Enum to keep parity with admin settings & frontend selects.

Endpoints under /admin/interim/* rely entirely on AdminAuthMiddleware — there is no explicit `Depends(get_current_admin)` inside the route, so unit-testing them in isolation requires going through the middleware. Acceptable but worth noting.
test_credentials: Company: 224620000001 / TestCompany2026! ; Admin: servispro@servisprogn.com / Servisproguinea2026# ; Provider: created on-the-fly via direct MongoDB insert (cleaned up after run)
seed_data_creation: Each test run inserts a fresh provider in service_providers and tears it down after. A few TEST_-prefixed missions remain in servispro_dev.interim_missions (status open / completed) — they do not interfere with future runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_interim.py runs against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL with the seeded TestCompany (224620000001 / TestCompany2026!) and the hardcoded admin account. Provider account is auto-created via direct MongoDB insert (the /api/auth/register endpoint requires profile_photo + Cloudinary so direct DB insert is faster and more reliable). The suite resets commission_percent to 10 at the start, then to 15 mid-run; the final test pass leaves the global setting at whatever value was last set — I manually reset it to 10 after the run.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bug found in the interim module. The minor 500 on /api/auth/register without a profile photo is in the pre-existing auth code, not the interim module, and is documented as a minor issue.
